ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(SBQQ__Status__c ), CASE( TEXT(SBQQ__Status__c ), "Draft", 1, "In Review", 2, "Approval Pending", 3, "Approved", 4, "Rejected", 5, "Presented", 6, "Denied", 7, "Accepted", 8, 0 ) < CASE( TEXT(PRIORVALUE(SBQQ__Status__c )), "Draft", 1, "In Review", 2, "Approval Pending", 3, "Approved", 4, "Rejected", 5, "Presented", 6, "Denied", 7, "Accepted", 8, 0 ), NOT($Permission.BypassValidations) )
